content.text: {"core": "Creation completes and releases what has finished forming, passing the sealed whole across the threshold into the world. In Wisdom, the egress opens onto held inner knowing — insight ready to leave the interior. Too Much, the release fires ahead of the seed's forming, so knowing is delivered before it has cohered, and half-set understanding exits as if whole.", "sheetLine": "The gate opens too early; the knowing leaves before it has set."}
